title: Garmin Run Singapore 2026 Review: Marina Barrage's Tech-Brand Half Marathon
seo_title: Garmin Run Singapore 2026 Review | Marina Barrage Race
meta_description: Garmin Run Singapore 2026: October 25 at Marina Barrage. 21K and 10K from Garmin. Registration pending — Singapore's GPS-brand run reviewed.
dek: Set for 25 October 2026 at Marina Barrage — Singapore's iconic reservoir-and-skyline venue — this Garmin-branded run offers 21K and 10K distances. Registration isn't open yet. A tech-brand Singapore race at one of the city's most photogenic locations.
verdict: Garmin Run Singapore brings the global GPS-watch brand's running series to Marina Barrage — Singapore's dam-and-reservoir park with panoramic views of the Marina Bay skyline. Two distances (21K, 10K) keep it focused. Garmin's brand presence typically means tech-enhanced race features and premium merchandise. Registration isn't open yet, but for a tech-brand Singapore half marathon at one of the city's most photogenic venues, this is worth tracking.

sections.heading: Marina Barrage: Singapore's Skyline Venue
paragraphs: Marina Barrage is one of Singapore's most distinctive event venues — a reservoir-side park with sweeping views of the Marina Bay Sands, the Singapore Flyer, and the city skyline. [1] A Garmin-branded race here delivers the brand's signature data-enhanced race experience in a world-class urban setting.
